skills.skill_desc:
If Franco takes no damage for 5s, he gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> per second, and begins gaining <font color="a6aafb">Wasteland Force</font> (up to 10 stacks).
Franco's next skill consumes all <font color="a6aafb">Wasteland Force</font> stacks, increasing its damage by up to 150%.

Franco launches an <font color="a6aafb">Iron Hook</font> in the target direction. The hook snags the first enemy unit hit, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and dragging them to him.
Franco lashes out, dealing 300 (+ 4% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies, slowing them by 70% for 1.5s.

Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8s and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing 50<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
